name: std::chrono::weekday_indexed::weekday_indexed

declarations.code: constexpr weekday_indexed(const std::chrono::weekday &wd, unsigned index) noexcept;

intro:
Constructs a weekday_indexed.

1) Default constructor leaves both the std::chrono::weekday and the index value uninitialized.

2) Constructs a weekday_indexed storing the weekday wd and the index index. The values held are unspecified if !wd.ok() || index > 7.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: A more convenient way to construct a weekday_indexed is with weekday's operator[], i.e., wd[index].
